title: polyjose conformance results file
description: The results of one conformance runner's run over every file under conformance/vectors/ (ADR 0034 §2). Each runner writes it to target/conformance/<runner>.json, or target/conformance/<runner>-<suffix>.json for a CI matrix run or a non-reference Rust build; scripts/conformance-parity.sh compares every such file with the rust-core reference run (ADR 0034 §4, §5, §8). conformance/README.md (Binding runners) has the rules. Every object is closed.

runner.description: The runner name of ADR 0034 §2, without any file-name suffix. scripts/conformance-parity.sh takes its list of runners from this enum.

polyjose.description: The polyjose version the runner tested: the binding's version() (ADR 0030 §4), or the crate version for the Rust runners.

vectors_digest.description: The vector set the runner read (ADR 0060 §1-§3): the lowercase hex SHA-256 over the byte-sorted lines <id> TAB <lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's raw bytes> LF, one per vector file whose bytes the runner read and parsed, computed by the runner with its platform's own SHA-256, never polyjose's (ADR 0060 §5). scripts/conformance-parity.sh requires it to equal rust-core.json's and refuses the digest of the empty input (ADR 0060 §6). conformance/README.md (Binding runners) has the definition and a shell reference.

features.description: The vector feature names (conformance/README.md, Features) this build enables, in the order of conformance/schema.json's features enum. The bindings and the rust-core reference build enable none (ADR 0034 §3, §4).

error_codes.description: The stable error codes the runner's library reports, in order: the binding's error_codes() (ADR 0030 §4), or Error::CODES for the Rust runners (ADR 0034 §8).

results.description: One entry per vector file found under conformance/vectors/, in any order. Ids are unique.

id.description: The vector id (ADR 0034 §1, ADR 0045 §4): the file's path under conformance/vectors/, with / separators, then #0, since every file holds one vector.

source.description: Optional: the vector's source member, reported alongside the id (ADR 0034 §1). Not compared.

op.description: The vector's operation member, as written.

actual.description: The observed outcome of the operation: { "ok": true }, or { "ok": false, "error": <code> } with the library's error code.

result.description: One vector's result: pass, fail or skipped.

pass.description: The vector ran and met its expectation. actual is required.

fail.description: The vector failed: a wrong outcome, a failed round trip, a schema-invalid or unreadable file, an unknown or unmapped operation, or an exception in the harness (ADR 0034 §3). reason says why. op is present when the file named one; actual is present when the operation returned an outcome.

skipped.description: The vector lists in features a feature the build does not enable (ADR 0034 §3), or in features_absent one it enables (ADR 0056): reason is feature: and those names, comma-separated, the missing ones first in the vector's features order, then each enabled one as !<name> in its features_absent order. There is no actual.
